name: qq-history-export
description: Exports supported text messages from a selected classic mobile QQ SQLite snapshot (com.tencent.mobileqq, the pre-NT 8.x line), obtained from a rooted Android device or emulator. Frida 16 observes Java-heap plaintext to recover a variable-period XOR field key and verify it against independent known messages. Short and long text messages are then decoded offline into JSONL. Export requires database-bound key/account evidence and 100% UTF-8 decoding coverage of selected supported text fields. This coverage does not establish whole-account completeness; real-device/client compatibility still requires validation. Databases, key/evidence bundles, and exports stay in a verified private companion repository.
